Overview

The hidden cost of Blockchain & Digital Trust for 3PL & Freight Forwarding is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on TMS execution, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. In Logistics & Supply Chain the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: GDPR / privacy regimes shapes what data may move, dwell time dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
